written_at_stage: preparation only; this document is sealed before any execution and is never rewritten
self_hash_note: this file deliberately carries no hash of itself. The aggregator embeds its sha256 as PIN_PREREG and re-hashes it at preflight, so the seal is external and cannot be forged from inside the document.

purpose.one_sentence: Read the already-committed evidence of J19A, J19B, J19C, K1R1, the J20 critic-only warm-up and the J20 R3 restore audit, verify every binding property and every pinned byte, and - only if all of it holds - attest that the EXISTING J20 warm-up checkpoint is TRAINING_READY as an INPUT checkpoint for a future conservative PPO pilot.
purpose.what_it_is_not: it is not permission to launch anything. It is an attestation about an artefact, not an authorisation of an action.
purpose.why_a_separate_stage: R3 closed G9 and, by its own preregistration, authorises nothing. Aggregating the closed gates into a readiness statement is a different act with a different blast radius, and it must be preregistered and reviewed on its own terms.
what_it_does_not_do: it does not train: no training code is imported and none is reachable
it does not sample and does not roll out
it does not start Ray, does not construct an Algorithm and does not construct an environment
it does not import train_ppo_mlp, ray, torch, numpy, gymnasium, opensim or any simulation module
it does not launch, schedule or authorise a pilot
it does not modify any production file, configuration, checkpoint or prior leaf
it does not write into the warm-up leaf, whose RESTORE_AUDIT_PENDING marker stays byte-immutable
it does not promote anything to deployable
it does not retry, under any outcome

lineage.operational: August V26 imitation -> J2 35D -> J8 -> J18 c13 -> J19A -> J19B / J19C -> J20 critic-only warm-up -> J20 R3 restore audit
lineage.student: one single native 35D actor. No separate 25D, no widening, no contralateral feature.
lineage.july: INFORMATIONAL ONLY. July is a methodological source and a diagnostic reference band. It is NOT an operational input to any stage aggregated here, and the aggregator fails closed if a July artefact appears among the operational inputs.
lineage.how_it_is_checked: gate T1 verifies that the pinned operational input set contains no July leaf, that J19A's recorded parent is the J18 leaf, and that the lineage string recorded in the result equals the one above.

identified_by.files: all 24 files of the checkpoint tree, pinned individually

the_object_under_attestation.the_attestation_is_about_this_object_and: not about a pilot, not about a protocol, not about a deployment.

readiness_scope.why_this_section_exists: 'training_ready' has to mean something precise or it means nothing. It is scoped here, exhaustively, to a named hash-identified object and a named list of properties.
training_ready_true_asserts_exactly: the checkpoint exists, every one of its 24 files matches its pin, and it is byte-identical to the one J20 wrote

it reloads through the REAL production path train_ppo_mlp.run -> algo.restore_from_path, proven by R3 at 13/13, and comes back exact: the full sixteen-key module, the actor digest, the critic digest, the log-std slice, sigma, the six Adam moment pairs, every Adam step, and - under rev7 - the learning rate the restore itself produced
the actor it carries is the J19A actor, bit-exact, and that actor is offline-eligible on all eleven binding criteria and reproducible on all thirty-six exact fields
that actor qualified closed-loop 6/6 on A-F and 3/3 on held-out G-I, with the actor unchanged across every cell
no cell breached the binding penetration threshold, under the current pinned contract
every FSM v3 and morphology incident counter is zero across all nine cells and across the warm-up's 4096 recorded rows
the critic was trained and changed while the actor and the log-std stayed bit-exact, over exactly one logical iteration of exactly 4096 sampled steps, with the worker weights synchronised once
nothing upstream of this attestation ever claimed promotion, training readiness or a next-stage authorisation
training_ready_true_does_NOT_assert: that any pilot configuration is correct, safe or sealed
that any launch command is correct or approved
that the hyperparameters, iteration count, stopping rule, safety monitors or rollback plan of a pilot exist
that the resulting policy is deployable, safe on hardware, or fit for a subject
that a pilot will converge, or that it is a good idea
anything at all about July as an operational baseline

the_pilot_protocol_is_NOT_SEALED.status: AT THE TIME THIS DOCUMENT IS WRITTEN, no pilot configuration file and no pilot launch command exist, are pinned, or are approved.
the_pilot_protocol_is_NOT_SEALED.consequence: J21 attests CHECKPOINT readiness, not PILOT readiness. These are different objects and the distinction is load-bearing.
the_pilot_protocol_is_NOT_SEALED.what_is_forbidden: the aggregator must NOT invent, propose, derive or pin a pilot config or a launch command. If it did, it would be manufacturing evidence for a thing that does not exist.
the_pilot_protocol_is_NOT_SEALED.why_this_does_not_make_the_attestation_e: the readiness_scope above is a closed list of properties of a hash-identified artefact, every one of which is measured from committed evidence. A future pilot still needs its own preregistration, its own GO and its own user authorisation; what it will NOT need is to re-litigate whether this checkpoint is sound.

accepted_diagnostics_disclosed.why_this_section_exists: a readiness statement that hides its own caveats is worth nothing. These are recorded here BEFORE any execution, and the aggregator reproduces them in its result rather than discovering them.

promotion_semantics.definition: the checkpoint may be used as the RESUME INPUT of a future conservative PPO pilot that is itself separately preregistered, separately reviewed and separately authorised. Nothing else.
promotion_semantics.training_ready_is_never_true_without_a_f: there is no partial credit. Fifteen of fifteen or nothing.

fail_closed_conditions: any pinned artefact missing, unreadable or hash-changed
any required field absent from any evidence file - a missing field is a FAILURE, never a default

any stale marker: the warm-up leaf not carrying RESTORE_AUDIT_PENDING, or carrying a pass marker; the R3 leaf not carrying RESTORE_AUDIT_PASSED, or still carrying TECHNICAL_INVALID; either earlier restore-audit leaf having lost TECHNICAL_INVALID
contradictory lineage: a July artefact among the operational inputs, a recorded parent that is not the J18 leaf, or a lineage string that does not match
any hard-binding penetration breach, in any cell, by any sample
any non-zero FSM v3 or morphology target counter, in any cell or in the warm-up training health
any actor digest mismatch, anywhere it is recorded
any evidence that J21 itself constructs runtime, starts Ray, constructs an environment, samples, rolls out or trains
any upstream receipt claiming promotion, training readiness or a next-stage authorisation

protocol.no_clobber: the aggregator refuses to start if the destination exists
protocol.born_invalid: the leaf is created with TECHNICAL_INVALID written FIRST, before anything else, and the aggregator asserts that marker is the only resident before evaluating
protocol.marker_removed_last: TECHNICAL_INVALID is replaced by TRAINING_READY_ATTESTED only after all fifteen gates pass AND post-commit verification passes
protocol.post_commit_verification: every leaf-relative path named by the committed receipt is re-hashed against the receipt and against the bytes that were written, and every pinned artefact is re-hashed
protocol.single_execution: one evaluation, no loop, no retry under any outcome, and NO subprocess of any kind
protocol.go_required: --execute refuses to run without a valid architect GO whose status is exactly APPROVED, whose stage is exactly V26C_J21_TRAINING_READY_ATTESTATION and whose closed set of pins all re-hash correctly
protocol.inert_modes: --preflight-only and --dry-run write nothing and launch nothing
protocol.implementation_constraint: STANDARD LIBRARY ONLY. hashlib, json, pathlib, argparse, sys, os, ast, datetime. No third-party import at any level.

what_success_still_does_not_authorise: launching a training run of any kind

prohibitions: no execution without BOTH explicit user authorisation and an APPROVED architect GO for stage V26C_J21_TRAINING_READY_ATTESTATION
no write of any kind into the warm-up leaf, the R1, R2 or R3 restore-audit leaves, or any J19 leaf
no modification of any production file, configuration, checkpoint or preregistration
no import of train_ppo_mlp, ray, torch, numpy, gymnasium, opensim or any simulation module
no subprocess, no ray.init, no Algorithm construction, no environment construction, no sampling, no rollout, no training
no invention of a pilot configuration or a launch command
no promotion beyond TRAINING_INPUT_ONLY, and never deployable
